race.comment: GLOCK 'N' ROLL (4) is the top pick after two solid runs this campaign off a long break, including a narrow second at Halidon and a Gawler fifth when overrun late. He's third-up, already placed at 1200m and brings the right profile to break through. LITTLE ROCKET (6) is the main danger, having beaten GLOCK 'N' ROLL home at Gawler two starts ago before a luckless seventh when held up and interfered with late. LIGHT BRIGADE (5) has upside second-up after making ground from well back in town and his debut third at this track reads well for a maiden of this depth. DANNY'S DILEMMA (2) has to put a disappointing debut behind him, but his close second in a recent Murray Bridge trial gives him enough fresh interest to be included among the chances. NOAH'S ARK (8) lacks tactical speed but possesses a strong turn of foot on his day. If the pace is strong watch for Toeroek rounding them up.
